jararaca.title: Snake hissing.mp3

bee.title: Honey Bees Buzzing
bee.author: kiwimana
bee.note: Actual honey bees returning to their hive, summer 2016, Waitakere Ranges, Auckland, New Zealand. Uploader does not give a species-level taxonomic identification.

gila.title: Wind on bushes with muffled gust of wind, twig branch, close to desert ground
gila.author: Félix Blume (felix.blume)
gila.note: Actual desert wind/bush field recording in California, USA, November 2011. This is ambience, not a Gila monster vocalization or a verified Gila monster habitat recording.
gila.processing: 18-second excerpt from 1 second into public HQ MP3 preview; 0.4-second fade in, 0.7-second fade out; MP3 128 kbps. Only a prefix of the long public preview was downloaded. Gain +14 dB.

cone.title: Underwater crackling sounds_Hydrophone.wav
cone.author: KaleidacousticsAudio
cone.note: Actual hydrophone field recording from an anchored boat in a cove off Hvar, Croatia. The uploader attributes continuous crackling probably to pistol shrimp. This is underwater ambience, not a cone-snail sound or a verified Conus magus habitat recording.
cone.processing: 18-second excerpt from 1 second into public HQ MP3 preview; 0.4-second fade in, 0.7-second fade out; MP3 128 kbps. Only a prefix of the long public preview was required. Gain +4 dB.
